text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data without being programmed for every task. In supervised learning, a model is trained using labelled examples called training data. For instance, you can show a computer many emails marked as "spam" or "not spam." The model studies these examples and finds patterns. After training, it can make predictions about new emails it has never seen before. The accuracy of these predictions depends on the quality and amount of training data. A good model learns useful rules and applies them to real-world situations.
